# Toast routes

Every route toast's surface serves -- vendor-facing only. The `/__unit/*` control plane is the same for every vendor; see [Control plane](control-plane.md).

| Method | Path | Operation | Capability | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/authentication/v1/authentication/login` | Login | auth | Exchange clientId/clientSecret for a Bearer JWT; 401 on bad credentials; no refresh. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/prices` | OrderPrices | orders | Price an order body; persists nothing. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/orders` | OrderCreate | orders | Create an order: guids assigned, amounts computed, payments accepted. |
| GET | `/orders/v2/orders` | OrdersGet | orders | Deprecated: EVERY matching order guid, unpaged (none is documented; JUDGMENT, audit gap 12). |
| GET | `/orders/v2/ordersBulk` | OrdersBulkGet | orders | Full orders for a date range or business date; page from 0, pageSize <= 100. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/applicableDiscounts` | ApplicableDiscounts | orders | Which discounts apply to an order body. |
| GET | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}` | OrderGet | orders | One order; 400 malformed guid, 404 unknown. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}/void` | OrderVoid | orders | Void an order and its OTHER payments; terminal. |
| PATCH | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}/deliveryInfo` | OrderDeliveryInfoPatch | orders | Update an order's deliveryInfo. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}/checks/{checkGuid}/selections` | CheckSelectionsPost | orders | Append selections to an open check; amounts recomputed. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}/checks/{checkGuid}/appliedDiscounts` | CheckDiscountsPost | orders | Apply CHECK-type discounts to a check. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}/checks/{checkGuid}/selections/{selectionGuid}/appliedDiscounts` | SelectionDiscountsPost | orders | Apply ITEM-type discounts to a selection. |
| POST | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}/checks/{checkGuid}/payments` | CheckPaymentsPost | payments | Add OTHER or pre-authorised CREDIT payments to a check; answers the Order. |
| PATCH | `/orders/v2/orders/{guid}/checks/{checkGuid}/payments/{paymentGuid}` | PaymentTipPatch | payments | Set a payment's tipAmount; answers the Order. |
| GET | `/orders/v2/payments` | PaymentsGet | payments | Payment guids for exactly one of paidBusinessDate, refundBusinessDate, voidBusinessDate. |
| GET | `/orders/v2/payments/{guid}` | PaymentGet | payments | One payment by guid. |
| GET | `/menus/v3/menus` | MenusV3Get | menus | The published V3 menu document: menus, groups, items and the three reference maps. |
| GET | `/menus/v3/metadata` | MenusV3MetadataGet | menus | {restaurantGuid, lastUpdated} -- poll this before re-fetching the menu. |
| GET | `/config/v2/diningOptions` | ConfigDiningOptionsGet | config | Every DiningOption; lastModified filter; Toast-Next-Page-Token paging. |
| GET | `/config/v2/diningOptions/{guid}` | ConfigDiningOptionGet | config | One DiningOption by guid. |
| GET | `/config/v2/alternatePaymentTypes` | ConfigAlternatePaymentTypesGet | config | Every AlternatePaymentType; lastModified filter; Toast-Next-Page-Token paging. |

| GET | `/config/v2/taxRates/{guid}` | ConfigTaxRateGet | config | One TaxRate by guid. |
| GET | `/config/v2/revenueCenters` | ConfigRevenueCentersGet | config | Every RevenueCenter; lastModified filter; Toast-Next-Page-Token paging. |

| GET | `/restaurants/v1/restaurants/{restaurantGUID}` | RestaurantGet | restaurants | One restaurant: general, location, urls, schedules, delivery, onlineOrdering, prepTimes. |
| GET | `/restaurants/v1/groups/{managementGroupGUID}/restaurants` | RestaurantGroupRestaurantsGet | restaurants | Every restaurant in a management group. |
| GET | `/partners/v1/connectedRestaurants` | PartnersConnectedRestaurantsGet | partners | The restaurants connected to this partner, in the documented page envelope. |
| GET | `/partners/v1/restaurants` | PartnersRestaurantsGet | partners | The same rows as a bare array. |
| GET | `/stock/v1/inventory` | StockInventoryGet | stock | Every OUT_OF_STOCK or QUANTITY item (IN_STOCK omitted); ?status narrows to one. |
| POST | `/stock/v1/inventory/search` | StockInventorySearch | stock | Stock for the named guids / multiLocationIds, IN_STOCK included; unknown ones are INVALID. |
| PUT | `/stock/v1/inventory/update` | StockInventoryUpdate | stock | Set IN_STOCK, OUT_OF_STOCK or QUANTITY (with quantity > 0) on items. |
| POST | `/__toast/webhooks/subscriptions` | RegisterWebhookSubscription | webhooks | Stand-in (not a Toast endpoint): add a subscription -- an HTTPS URL, categories, and a per-subscription secret. |
| GET | `/__toast/webhooks/subscriptions` | ListWebhookSubscriptions | webhooks | Stand-in (not a Toast endpoint): every subscription, with its secret. |
| DELETE | `/__toast/webhooks/subscriptions/{guid}` | RemoveWebhookSubscription | webhooks | Stand-in (not a Toast endpoint): remove a subscription (Toast: 'contact the Integrations team'). |
